text: In term 1, Awn referred 55% of the students who ended the term struggling (between 53% and 57%), so it missed 45% of them. The analysis did not test whether the support that follows a referral helps, and the rule is known to be less reliable for two groups: it wrongly refers many students with a remote-attendance accommodation and misses most struggling bridging-year entrants. The result describes groups of students and must not be used to judge, rank or list any individual student.
